description: Every signal collector is registered behind a circuit breaker — a failing or malformed source disables that collector, redistributes its weight, and surfaces the degradation in output; malformed input must never crash the score path.

requirements.description: Every signal collector must be registered behind a circuit breaker. When a collector fails (panics, returns error, or produces malformed output), the circuit breaker must: (1) disable that collector for the current request, (2) redistribute the disabled collector's weight proportionally among the remaining healthy collectors, and (3) include a degradation notice in the score response output identifying which collector was disabled and its original weight. A malformed or missing source artifact must never cause a panic or unhandled error that crashes the score path. The circuit breaker registration and weight redistribution logic must be covered by unit tests using fixture artifact directories.
requirements.title: Circuit Breaker Per Signal Collector with Weight Redistribution and Degradation Surface
